why: One cell of vs-quad-02's top-right corner, column 32 of its P row, turned from open floor to solid, breaking the column mirror the board's notes claim (column 0 of the same row stays open). Modelled on `quad-board-loses-its-mirror-symmetry` for issue #1036, and for its reason: the board still loads, connects and passes every count-based check, so only the symmetry block notices. Anchored on the P row, which is unique in arenas.json, so it cannot match another board or another row of this one.
